summary_text: In May 2026, the user purchased fresh, unbranded vegetable staples on two independent dates (2026-05-01 and 2026-05-12). Onion (400–450 g) is the only product variant to recur across these dates, meeting the repetition bar for stable preference. Other items—Green Capsicum, Potato, Coriander leaves, and Green Chillies—appear on single dates only and are excluded from stable preference claims. All purchases occurred during the evening on weekdays, a pattern supported by two independent observations.

stable_preference_claims.claim_text: The user has a stable preference for Onion (400–450 g), observed on two independent dates in May 2026.

uncertainty_text: This analysis is based on two independent orders in May 2026. While Onion shows a stable pattern, other vegetable purchases are single-date observations and do not indicate durable preference. No demographic, household, or occasion-based inferences are made.
